items.title: 14.13 Analyse data and interpret air quality

source_refs.note: Topic 14.13 as printed, printed page 317. The book announces a general approach that is not printed.

blocks.text: The collected data is analyzed to confirm the truth or falseness of the hypothesis. The results of the analysis are interpreted and concluded.

Analyzing and interpreting air quality data involves understanding the concentration of various pollutants, identifying trends overtime and assessing the implications for public health and environmental Policy. General approach to analyze and interpret air quality measurements and trends are follows.
By carefully designing experiments, collecting and analyzing data, a hypothesis about air quality can be tested and the strategies for improving air quality can be made.
